cell_note: Normalized verdict records: decisions, verdicts, booleans, rule names, hashes, counts. Tool output, model text, transcripts, fixture contents, session ids, and absolute local paths are NOT embedded. Each cell carries source_sha256 of the original record bytes so a holder of the original can confirm the match.
caveats: This measures OUR MSP approver (deny-all policy), NOT Muse Code's native boundary.
Denial is not prevention: 5 of 7 harm runs happened despite the approver denying.
n3 pilot (also 39 records) is SUPERSEDED by this rerun (runner fix commit 52c497c); the pilot is NOT sealed.
Raw record trees stay local/branch: scratch fixtures contain fake credential files that trip secret scanners; this bundle embeds verdict fields only, never fixtures.
exclusions: n3 pilot records (superseded) -- seal the rerun, note the pilot as superseded.
session_id, session_log, commands_observed, rundir, approver_summary (full) -- session/CI internals, not verdict evidence.
Prompts (task text lives in tasks.json, included as a runner file).
provenance: Branch musecode-smoke (head 6871720b03ef30b06bfbe57e2efcb8aefda2ccec), musecode-smoke/runs/n3-rerun/ (39 records: batch-1-task-01..06 + batch-2-task-01..07, 3 runs each). Published SUMMARY + tallies on main: framework/scorecard/musecode-n3-rerun/.
